answer: One worker, one union card: the trade union signs a fresh challenge binding the agent's key to one dues-paying membership, and the vertex of that membership — one worker, one workplace, one dues record — is re-checked against the roll every epoch. A second key claiming the same card is rejected, since the union holds the roll. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real memberships at roughly $400 a year in dues and employment proof, about $400,000, plus a terrace of workplace checks no script can fake — and any membership can be struck on fraud, leaving a reef of dead cards none can reuse.
